m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read existing source files: config.py, utilization.py, test_gold_cycle_config.py, gold_defaults.toml, run.py. Confirm handoff is complete.

m1-red-tests.title: Write failing tests (TDD RED)
m1-red-tests.imperative: Add tests to test_gold_cycle_config.py: (1) utilization defaults to 'balanced' when absent; (2) valid levels accepted; (3) invalid level raises GoldCycleConfigError naming field/expected/actual; (4) _config_to_raw round-trips utilization; (5) _apply_utilization_hint sets config.runtime.utilization in gold mode without raising and applied_overrides stays empty; (6) smoke --utilization override works via apply_cli_overrides path. Run tests — expect RED.
constraints: touch only test file; no impl yet

m2-config-impl.title: Implement config.py changes
m2-config-impl.imperative: Add utilization: str to GoldCycleRuntimeConfig; in _parse_and_validate read runtime.utilization optional defaulting 'balanced', validate against UTILIZATION_LEVELS; in _config_to_raw emit runtime.utilization; in _apply_overrides_to_raw section_map add utilization->runtime.

preconditions.statement: red tests written and confirmed failing

constraints: import UTILIZATION_LEVELS from src.utils.utilization; do not redefine

m3-toml.title: Add utilization to gold_defaults.toml
m3-toml.imperative: Add `utilization = "balanced"` to [runtime] section in configs/evo/gold_defaults.toml with a short comment.

m4-run-py.title: Add --utilization to run.py gold-cycle subparser and _apply_utilization_hint
m4-run-py.imperative: Add --utilization {background,balanced,max} default None to gold_cycle subparser; add _apply_utilization_hint(config, args) helper that sets config.runtime.utilization = args.utilization only when not None; call it in cmd_gold_cycle AFTER config is loaded/overrides applied, OUTSIDE apply_cli_overrides.
constraints: CLI default is None; never passes through apply_cli_overrides; never lands in applied_overrides

m5-green.title: Run tests GREEN
m5-green.imperative: Run py -m pytest tests/unit/evo_predictor/test_gold_cycle_config.py -q. Confirm all pass including new utilization tests.

m6-evidence.title: Produce required evidence: simplification_limits
m6-evidence.imperative: Run py -m src.utils.simplification_limits --paths src/evo_predictor/gold_cycle/config.py src/evo_predictor/run.py tests/unit/evo_predictor/test_gold_cycle_config.py. Confirm clean.
